name: Acetabular Fracture
definition: Fracture involving the acetabular articular surface, usually after high-energy trauma but also occurring as fragility injury in older adults.

core: Sciatic nerve and distal vascular exam

investigations.principle: CT defines columns/walls and joint congruity; AP pelvis/Judet views supplement classification.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when the condition-specific question requires soft-tissue, neural, marrow or occult-injury assessment.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs/CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Surgery depends on displacement, congruity, stability and patient factors.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Shroni-bhagna framework may be documented only after modern fracture planning.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture involving the acetabular articular surface, usually after high-energy trauma but also occurring as fragility injury in older adults.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
